name: Kasuga Nozomi
source:
16 or 17 years old (depending on chosen birthday).

A second year high school girl.
She was sent to another world where Genji and Heike fought and chosen as a miko by Hakuryu (White Dragon).
Wishing to return to her own world, she choose to fight alongside Genji during their war against Heike.
After obtained the power to travel into spacetime and losing her allies in a war, she resolved to use it to help them and change their fates.

Translated from [url=http://www.gamecity.ne.jp/haruka3ultimate/characters.html]official website of Haruka 3 Ultimate[/url]]
